<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a reaction that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (both are valid functional group names) and forms a new C‑C bond, which matches the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"]
}
</action_input>
